mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever wondered just how much of who we are is shaped by the world around us... and how much is really set in stone by biology? Welcome to a journey where we’ll question what we think we know about gender, and maybe even surprise ourselves along the way. Together, we’ll explore the powerful mix of neuroscience, culture, and the stories we’re told—stories that shape our expectations, our opportunities, and even how we see ourselves. Inspired by Cordelia Fine’s eye-opening book, Delusions of Gender: How Our Minds, Society, and Neurosexism Create Difference, we’ll dive into a world where scientific research and cultural myths often collide. Fine invites us to look beyond the surface—challenging the idea that men and women are simply born to be different, and showing how deeply social influences and unconscious biases can shape what we mistake for biological truth. We’ll uncover how subtle cues and everyday expectations can reinforce stereotypes, sometimes even holding us back from what we’re truly capable of. And as we unravel the concept of neurosexism—the hidden biases that sneak into how we interpret and talk about neuroscience—you’ll see just how much room there is for change, growth, and reimagining what’s possible. So, if you’re ready to challenge old assumptions and open your mind to new possibilities, let’s begin this thoughtful, eye-opening exploration together.
